summary.name: Unfoldly
summary.one_liner: Unfoldly is a local-first AI search app that finds photos, video moments, and answers inside your personal files by meaning rather than filename.
keywords: search photos by what is in them
search pdf and docx by meaning
use_cases: Finding a photo by describing what is in it
Locating a video by describing a moment
Asking questions about the contents of local documents
Searching private files without uploading them to the cloud
Following up on answers with the relevant source kept in context
summary.what_it_does: Unfoldly indexes folders the user selects on their device and lets them search by meaning across photos, videos, audio and documents. Images are searched by what is inside them rather than by filename, and videos can be found by describing a moment. For documents, it first locates the relevant local file and then answers follow-up questions while keeping that source in context. The page says indexes, models and chat history stay on the device when local models are used. Supported formats listed include PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, EPUB, XLSX, CSV, PPTX, JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP, MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, MP4, MOV, MKV and AVI, among others.
notable: Local-first indexing with user-selected folders only
Search images by content and videos by described moment
Open-source codebase and curated open models (Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Llama)
No account required to use the app
caveats: Needs an internet connection to download models or app updates
Page does not state pricing or the platforms it runs on
